versions.changelog:
- Initial public release of "local-business-live-cycle" skill.
- Provides AI-powered assistant for local business owners: store diagnosis, video scriptwriting, livestream preparation, script frameworks, data review, and Q&A.
- Features 6 modes with simple trigger phrases for quick use.
- Supports main local business categories: catering, beauty, hospitality, kids, and retail.
- Includes step-by-step diagnostic flow with actionable, prioritized advice.  
- User-friendly: no extra software needed, focused on owner self-service.
